lead: Roma Dasgupta was an Indian film actor, born on 6 April 1931 in Pabna.
She died on 17 January 2014 in Kolkata at the age of 82.
She has 33 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and Banga Bibhushan.
Below you will find a verified overview of Roma Dasgupta: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
